programme.desc: Mannskapet prøver å frakte maskinene over stigende elver for å grave ut den nye fjellgruven.

programme.desc: Flere uhell rammer Jade-mannskapet, og alle kommer opp med sine egne løsninger for å jage vekk demonene.

programme.desc: Etter endelig å ha oppdaget flere lovende steiner i Wolverine-gruven, oppdager mannskapet at de kanskje har gått ut forbi sitt erklærte område.

programme.title: Matlock: The Nightmare
programme.desc: A vacation to a wild west ghost town becomes more than Matlock bargained for as a bump on the head takes him straight back in time to the real old wild west, surrounded by familiar faces – with very unfamiliar occupations.

programme.title: Matlock: The Marriage Counselor
programme.desc: Matlock’s dull, droning insurance broker, Allan Corning finds therapy for his struggling marriage interrupted by the sudden murder of his therapist, Dr. Harding Fletcher.

programme.title: Matlock: The Dame
programme.desc: When Matlock is slapped by an attractive older woman in a restaurant, Ben recalls to Julie the story of his first case – the murder of the man who put him through law school.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Defense
programme.desc: After witnessing a violent argument between his parents, a distraught young man murders his abusive father.

programme.title: Matlock: The Game Show
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the defense of popular game show host Dennis Blake who’s accused of the murder of his successful, yet despised mega-millionaire producer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Foursome
programme.desc: A brash multimillionaire, Ellis Blake is held in the slaying of Jeffrey Holden, a handsome, young man who intended to marry Ellis’ daughter – without his blessing or consent.

programme.title: Matlock: The Picture (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s search for evidence to prove his client innocent of killing her husband uncovers a ring of counterfeiters who will pay any price, including murder, to keep their secret. Ben’s investigation uncovers ties to the mob.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock’s faith in his ability as a top-notch attorney is completely eroded when he’s dismissed by a client and replaced by a younger lawyer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 2)
programme.desc: During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide coverup.

programme.title: Matlock: The Abduction

programme.title: Matlock: Mr. Awesome

programme.title: Matlock: The Evening News (Part 1)

programme.title: Matlock: The Evening News (Part 2)

programme.title: Matlock: The Assassination (Part 2)
programme.desc: When his daughter is jailed for contempt Matlock takes over her case. Now it is up to him to uncover the truth behind a sinister cover-up that involves high government officials, including the Chief of Police, in a child pornography ring and a murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Vacation (Part 1)
programme.desc: When Matlock and his daughter Leanne arrive at a seaside resort to plan their new law partnership, they discover the manager has been murdered.

programme.desc: A jubilant Tony returns to boxing as the manager of a young heavyweight, thrilling Louie, who anticipates recouping his wagering losses to Alex by betting against Banta's boxer.

programme.desc: Louie carries his actions and insults too far, prompting Elaine to enlist help from a women's organization. Soon, the dispatcher's lecherous laughter is transformed into comical pleading when he is booted out of his job.

programme.desc: Joy blossoms at the Sunshine Cab Co. when a triumphant Bobby Wheeler returns to proclaim that he's landed a TV series role. Louie, in his own charming way, puts a damper on the celebration.

programme.desc: The pretty new cabbie proves to be more than Alex can handle when she leaves the meter running, in an attempt to lure him into romance.

programme.desc: Romance and merriment are on the menu for Tony and Alex when they double-date gorgeous twin models at a posh restaurant, only to have the intimate group grow to a crowd with the unwelcome additions of Jim and Alex's ex-wife.

programme.desc: Reverend Jim comes to the rescue when Alex is consumed by gambling fever after a lucky night in Atlantic City.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Today’s infantry demands a weapon combining machine gun firepower with rifle accuracy and mobility.. Host Wil Willis traces this journey through iconic firearms.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2014: Last Christmas

programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas install airbags on the 48 Dodge. Team gets ready for the Galveston Classic Car show.

programme.desc: George wants his 1967 Chevelle to be perfect, but his car has had more rats than repairs and the engine bay is too small for his dreams. Brian’s 1960 Lincoln is full of surprises, and he moment something else is fixed, a new problem surfaces.

programme.desc: FantomWorks dives into prototype hell to give Nick a superfast 1969 Chevrolet Chevelle with an LT4 engine. Barlen wants his mother’s 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air to run like a dream for her birthday. Unfortunately, her birthday is in 30 days.

programme.desc: Rick comes to FantomWorks for a nightmare combination of gadgets, gizmos, and upgrades for his 1972 Cadillac Hearse. Merlyn and Lynn are farmers from Minnesota with a 1959 Chevy Apache that’s so dangerous they’ve never driven it beyond their driveway.

programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Mustang fastback and a 1951 Studebaker truck. The mustang is for a friend whose plans are far bigger than his budget, and the Studebaker needs a unique design to make it a world-class show vehicle.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Ron and Valerie want Dan to restore their 1963 Jeep Willy’s Fleetvan, but the problems run deeper than the seams hidden beneath inches of filler. Grady’s Z28 breaks down so often that he’s never had it out of second gear.

programme.desc: Kim and Doug want to drive her father’s hyper-rare 1959 Thunderbolt, but the car was only set up for the racetrack. Batalla is a legendary motorcycle builder who asks Dan to restore his prized possession - a 1947 Knucklehead.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The 48 Dodge 4 door coupe are ready for the airbags to be installed. The 66 Corvette has a custom frame that is unique to Muscle Cars of Texas.

programme.desc: Mark returns to Oakland to become a police officer again and is reunited with his old partner. However, he discovers his old beat has become a storm of racial hatred.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: A veterans' support group becomes a lifeline for Commander Michaels, who continues to deal with post-traumatic stress disorder. Meanwhile, she discovers that her son David came into the emergency room due to an accident.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: Mark attends his high school class reunion and learns that some memories are bittersweet for his old friends.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: The problems of the handicapped are addressed when an amputee joins a crusade after a false fire alarm.

programme.desc: Mr. Zelinka is a beloved teacher who is being forced to retire because he's old. Jonathan and Mark know that he would prefer to continue teaching.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: The parents of two Vietnamese children come to America to look for them after a ten-year separation.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: After having been scarred in a fire, an actress becomes a counselor at a summer camp for blind children. The camp is run by Jonathan and Mark's blind friend Frank.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: A young man decides to institutionalize his brother who has been completely paralyzed and speechless for many years, against the wishes of their mother.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: Mark believes that God has turned Jonathan into a dog. Meanwhile, he must contend with a runaway kid and the kid's scatterbrained mother.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven

programme.title: Highway to Heaven

programme.desc: Jonathan helps the residents of Havencrest, when they learn that the retirement home is going to be sold. Jonathan must reveal his real identity to Mark in order to complete the assignment.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: Jonathan helps a terminally ill boy and his mother. Meanwhile, Mark deals with a thief abandoned by his folks.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark help aging movie heroes to stand up to a street gang known as Satan's Helpers. They persuade a young boxer not to throw a big fight when the gang tries to bully him.

programme.title: Highway to Heaven
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark assist a young country singer who is hoping to follow in her mother's footsteps. Next, they help a widow mourning her late husband.

programme.desc: Blake tilbyr seg å hjelpe Amanda med å finne faren sin. Claudia går ut på middag med Dean, mens Steven avviser Luke. Jeff og Nicole ligger med hverandre.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle føder før tiden og får en jente som lider av pusteproblemer. Hun oppkaller barnet etter en venn som en gang reddet livet hennes, Kristina.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Da Blake finner ut at han kan være Amandas far, bestemmer han seg for å be Amanda ta en blodprøve. Nicole forteller Jeff at det er en mulighet for at Peter DeVilbis kan ha vært sammen med en annen kvinne.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake kjøper tilbake veddeløpshesten Allegre fra eieren Daniel Reece, som sender Krystle en gave. Hun blir rasende og vil vite hvordan han tør å nærme seg henne etter det som skjedde med søsteren hennes, Iris.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle skværer opp med Daniel, som avslører at bruddet med søsteren hennes var minnelig. Claudia flytter inn på La Mirage.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Claudia avviser Stevens forsøk på forsoning. Spenningen mellom Dex og Amanda øker stadig. Tom Carrington skværer opp med Blake på sitt dødsleie.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle begynner å jobbe for Daniel. Blake er imot dette og krangler med Reece. Dex er rasende på Alexis for at hun dro til Sumatra for å møte faren til Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle lanserer sin nye virksomhet med å kjøpe en araberhest. Steven og Luke blir stadig mer tiltrukket av hverandre.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake vender triumferende tilbake fra forhandlingene med kineserne. Alexis sverger på å kjøpe seg inn i foretagendet. Krystle, som er ukomfortabel med Daniels økende oppmerksomhet, unngår ham.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis prøver å overtale lederen av den kinesiske delegasjonen til å hyre Colbyco. Blake er overrasket over å høre at Lady Ashley er i Acapulco.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Amanda tilbringer natten sammen med prins Michael, og blir knust da hun hører at han er forlovet. Dex overtaler den kinesiske delegasjonen til å hyre selskapet sitt i stedet for Blakes til en viktig borejobb.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Anspenheten mellom Krystle og Blake stiger i takt med mistenksomheten. Claudia angrer på at hun lå med Adam. Dominique forpurrer Alexis' forsøk på å kjøpe ut selskapet hennes.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dominique forblir i kritisk tilstand etter at hun kollapser. Luke kommer på uventet besøk til Steven. Blake forteller sønnen at han vil støtte ham på tross av hans legning.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis prøver å overtale kong Galen til å tillate giftermål mellom Amanda og sønnen hans. Hun prøver å lokke med at landet hans vil få en del av Colbycos inntekter.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis blir lettet, og Blake blir bekymret, når Amanda plutselig ombestemmer seg og vil gifte seg med prins Michael. Sammy Jo avsløres som synderen bak de kompromitterende fotografiene.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Claudia flyr til Mexico for å skille seg fra Steven. Adam dukker uventet opp på hotellet hennes, og de tilbringer natten sammen.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake og Daniel overlever flystyrten. Jeff leier et helikopter og trosser farlige værforhold, og finner til slutt flyvraket.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle blir med Daniel til New York slik at han kan gjenforenes med Sammy Jo, datteren han aldri har møtt.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom is furious after finding out that Lytell has taken his son Kyle into custody. Diana offers to help him in getting Kyle back. Meanwhile, Richard suspects that Collier is trying to take control of Lily's life.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro, a minor league baseball player, finds that he is hearing everyone's unspoken thoughts. His new found ability quickly drives him to the edge of madness.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Trent Appelbaum, a 4400 whose saliva causes rapid acceleration of a person's metabolism.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A school teacher terrifies parents with her ability to inspire talents within students. Meanwhile, Richard and Lily are confronted by police, and Jordan warns Shawn not to overuse his healing gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Maia sees a vision of Jordan Collier's death. Kyle's frightening blackouts are disrupting Tom's personal life. Diana is asked to hand over Maia's diary to NTAC.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: When Tom arrives at NTAC, he learns that no one has ever heard of the 4400. Tom and Diana track down a man to a museum, and during the chase, Tom finds a mysterious lab that only he can see.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate a 4400 who has released a plague that has wiped out an entire town's population. Meanwhile, a Washington D.C. lobbyist joins the 4400 Center in order to add some political muscle to the movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Edwin Mayuya, a 4400 who has the ability is to heal damaged fetal chromosomes while in utero. Unfortunately, it turns out this man is responsible for the slaughter of an entire clinic.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: NTAC follows a series of clues that lead them to Jordan Collier's killer. Tom faces a difficult choice when he must choose between the law or his family.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: 4400s across the world are coming down with strange and life threatening illnesses. Tom and Diana learn a horrible secret that the government may have directly caused the illnesses of the 4400s.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Discovering that NTAC is behind the disease plaguing the 4400s, Tom and Diana try to get to the bottom of NTAC's cover-up, while Kyle considers turning himself in.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana, with the help of Gary Navarro, try to track down T.J Kim, a 4400 whose ability they believe caused a man to stab Dennis Ryland. Richard and Lily are forced to deal with a now grown Isabelle.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro is arrested after attempting to assassinate Dennis Ryland. Isabelle attempts suicide in the hope of saving her mother, but fails when she survives a fall from the roof of the 4400 Center.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: T.J. Kim is murdered, and Tom is accused of committing the murder. Shawn and Isabelle grow closer.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Scotland, Dan venture through a vast, decaying Victorian psychiatric hospital. Untouched patient rooms and medical equipment lie abandoned. The team uncovers dark histories of overcrowding and mistreatment, while hunting for paranormal activity.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned car factory in Sicily where Fiat Panda, Punto, 500 and Lancia Ypsilon were built, closed in 2011 and now planned for reindustrialization.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned luxury hotel near Dubai, once built as a palace for Abu Dhabi rulers, closed since 2016 and now frozen in time.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Greeks Play Land, built in 1970 by The Greek for handicapped children using repurposed materials, was free to all but closed after his death due to lack of upkeep.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring abandoned military sites in France and Kuwait, from a NATO airbase with Soviet gear to Saddam Husseins vehicle graveyard on Failaka Island.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring Colorado’s abandoned mining sites and the forbidden ghost town of Gilman, closed in 1984 by the EPA due to toxic pollution.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: De single prøver å vise seg fra sin beste side for å konkurrere om parenes oppmerksomhet. Et par begynner å lære hvor vanskelig det er å motstå fristelser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En overraskelseseliminering vender opp ned på ting i husene. Parene dykker dypere inn i opplevelsen. Noen partnere opplever at de beveger seg lenger unna hverandre.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny twist får ting til å skje i begge villaene. Great og Nafeesah tar forholdet sitt til neste nivå. Hall kommer til en livsendrende konklusjon. Marisela gjenoppdager seg selv da skyldfølelsen begynner å sette inn for Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Fristelseslyset er en konstant påminnelse om at det ikke er noen hemmeligheter på øya og alle handlinger har konsekvenser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det er på tide med videomeldinger og Mark avslører en annen sjokkerende vri. De single får også lov til å sende videomeldinger. Hvem mottar en melding?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene håndterer ettervirkningene av videomeldinger i begge villaene. Nye relasjoner blir sterkere og mer intime. Andre begynner å slite med skyldfølelse og usikkerhet da slutten av oppholdet nærmer seg.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene drar på romantiske overnattingsdater med de beste single. Ny romantikk blomstrer, kjærlighetserklæringer og fremtidsplaner lages, og mer enn én person lar seg friste.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene Marisela & Christopher og Vanessa & Roberto gjenforenes for deres eksplosive siste bål. Var forholdet deres sterkt nok til å seire på Temptation Island?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Kaitlin & Hall og Paris & Great gjenforenes til sine siste bålseremonier. Bål har en egen evne til å avdekke sannheten – selv om denne sannheten har vært en løgn.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene og de single vender tilbake til en dramatisk gjenforening på 90 minutter etter tiden på øya.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En time med tidligere usett materiale, inkludert dramatiske øyeblikk fra bålseremoniene, avsløringer fra deltakerne og mye mer.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: ire nye par tar en reise til Temptation Island for å se om forholdet deres tåler alt.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlene flytter inn, og det går vilt for seg. Det første «bålet» byr på smertefulle oppvåkninger.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Noen par begynner å nyte sin nyvunnede uavhengighet, mens andre forblir fast i fortiden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Spenningen øker i villaene, og linjene blir uklare på Anything But Clothes-festen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Mark kommer med en uventet vending under elimineringen, noe som ryster deltakerne i begge villaene.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Følelsene er store etter det mest dramatiske bålet til nå. Overraskelsesgjester kommer for ryste stemningen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene sender videomeldinger til partnerne sine etter hvert som båndene til de single blir sterkere.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Etter videomeldingene – eller mangelen på disse – står parene overfor ny tvil og usikkerhet.
